$Comment: The temple hub's way out to the overworld: the game's own temple exit pad (its Parent, Forgotten_Temple_Portal_Exit: the pad players know leads out), with the plainer portal glow the game's hub portals wear, standing in the goblins' iron niche on the Concourse. Stepping on it, or pressing F on it, runs ZigOpen on the Overworld destination, the same way out the Porter offers: every instance at once, to where the player stood before they went in. It has no recipe and no category and is a Variant, so the creative library hides it, and like the pad it copies nobody can break it.
